theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Health Care (+1.48%) and Utilities (+0.38%) led the market today, while Industrials (-2.48%) and Materials (-1.41%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.36%, defensives +0.71%, and value/cyclicals -1.29% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.22%, Dow -0.57%, Nasdaq -0.31% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -1.17%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 0.87% to 15.14, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.70% to $4,141.20, crude oil was little changed at $88.26, and bitcoin slipped 2.72% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
